name: Thaumaturgy IV
description:
Chances to miss reduced by 25%.
Attacks POISON the target for 2 turns. Striking enemies triggers Chemical Reactions:
• ABLAZE -> VAPORIZE: 120% INT magic burst to all enemies.
• POISON -> BRITTLE TOXIN: +20% damage taken for 2 turns.
• FROZEN -> THERMAL SHOCK: Shatters freeze for +150% physical + 150% magical hybrid damage.

On death, POISONS, FREEZES, sets ABLAZE every enemy for 5 turns, STUNS them for 1 turn and confers ANOINTED to allies for 10 turns. Then, she is allowed by an ancient power to cast Catalytic Barrage one last time for 10× damage.

POISON: damage reduced by 20%
FREEZE: This unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn.
ABLAZE: takes 5% max hp as magic damage at the start of its turn
STUN: the unit skips its turn
ANOINTED: This unit deals 25% increased damage.
